threshold_rationale: LACE scores >= 13 correspond to top 10% of training cohort (n=7778). Observed abstain rate on training: 0.106. Heuristic but robust fallback when topological OOD detection fails validation gates.
known_limitations: Purely LACE-score-based, does not capture out-of-scope patients whose LACE is low but who are clinically outside the training distribution (e.g. pediatric with low LACE).
Simpler and more robust than topological, but less interpretable as a genuine OOD signal.
